away.body: Your mills kept turning and your fields kept growing.
away.title: While you were away…

buildings.description: Heart of your city. Upgrading the Citadel raises build speed and unlocks new building levels.
buildings.flavor: The last hearth of the warm lands.
buildings.name: Ember Citadel

buildings.description: Grows food to feed your troops. Higher levels harvest faster and store more.
buildings.flavor: Golden grain under a stubborn sun.
buildings.name: Sunfield Farm

buildings.description: Saws cinderwood into lumber for construction. Higher levels cut faster.
buildings.name: Cinderwood Mill

buildings.description: Quarries basalt stone for walls and engines. Higher levels dig faster.
buildings.name: Basalt Quarry

buildings.description: Mints gold from ember ore. Gold pays for research, training, and commanders.
buildings.flavor: Coins stamped with a living flame.
buildings.name: Ember Mint

buildings.description: Trains your troops. Higher levels train faster and unlock stronger tiers with research.
buildings.flavor: Where soft villagers become hard soldiers.
buildings.name: Ashguard Barracks

buildings.description: Researches technologies that boost your economy and army. Gates Tier 2 and Tier 3 troops.
buildings.flavor: Knowledge is the kindling of victory.
buildings.name: Pyrelight Academy

buildings.description: Raises your city's defense and (with PvP in phase 2) protects your stores.
buildings.flavor: Glass-black stone. The Frost breaks here.
buildings.name: Obsidian Walls

rarityFlavor.common: A steady warden of the hearth.
rarityFlavor.epic: A legend the Frost itself fears.
rarityFlavor.rare: A hero sung of in the warm halls.

commanders.subtitle: Recruit legendary wardens to lead your marches.
commanders.title: Wardens of the Ember

enemy.defeatLine: The cold takes its toll. Regroup by the hearth and try again.
enemy.description: An endless winter crawling down from the Whiteout. Its packs den in the wilds, growing bolder every day.
enemy.name: The Frost
enemy.victoryLine: The Frost recoils. Warmth holds — for now.

quests.subtitle: Small deeds, warm rewards. New quests kindle each dawn.
quests.title: Daily Hearth-Quests

relief.body: Scouts found a weaker pack nearby. An easier fight, if you want it.
relief.title: The Frost overreached

research.description: Marches move 10% faster; see frost node strength from farther away.
research.name: Frostwatch

shieldStub: Shields arrive with PvP wars — phase 2. For now, the Frost is the only enemy, and it never raids your stores.
tagline: Hold the last warm light against the Frost.

archers.description: Longbow volleys of burning pitch. Strong against infantry.
archers.name: Sparkshot Archers

cavalry.description: Fast riders wreathed in cinders. Strong against archers.
cavalry.name: Ember Riders

siege.description: Slow engines that hurl molten rock. Devastating to fortifications.
siege.name: Magma Trebuchets

tutorial.complete: The hearth is lit, Warden. Emberfall is yours to grow.

steps.body: Your people need food before they can fight. Tap the glowing tile and raise a farm — it's on the house.
steps.title: Raise a Sunfield Farm

steps.body: The Frost dens in the wilds beyond your walls. Train Ashguard, then march out and drive a pack back.
steps.title: Strike a frost pack

steps.body: Great armies need great leaders. Light the summoning pyre and welcome a Warden of the Ember.
steps.title: Recruit a Warden

tutorial.title: Kindle your citadel

welcome.subtitle: A gift each day you return — no streaks to break, no punishment for missing one.
welcome.title: Seven Dawns
